item.title: Apple Bars Under‑18 Use of Dating & AI Companion Apps
item.description: Apple's new App Store rules force dating and AI companion apps to carry an 18+ rating, add descriptors, and flag location‑sharing for child safety.

item.title: Australia’s Under-16 Social Media Ban Shows Limited Impact
item.description: Australia’s social media ban for under-16s has seen minimal impact, with teens using VPNs and parental help to bypass restrictions, per eSafety report.

item.title: Apple Updates Child Safety Features
item.description: Apple is updating its child safety features in iOS 27, iPad OS 27, and macOS 27.
